name: Newmillerdam
blurb: Our salon at 4 Castle Meadows is in neighbouring Hall Green — a short stroll from Newmillerdam Country Park. If you walk your dog round the lake, we're round the corner.

name: Crigglestone
blurb: Five minutes up the road from Crigglestone village. Easy parking outside the salon, no city-centre traffic.

name: Sandal
blurb: Just south of Sandal — a quick run down the A61. We see plenty of Sandal regulars after their morning walk at Pugneys.

name: Walton
blurb: Five minutes from Walton village. If your dog comes back from Anglers covered in lake water, we'll have them dry and tidy by tea-time.

name: Chapelthorpe
blurb: A short run from Chapelthorpe. Same WF4 postcode area — most of our Chapelthorpe customers walk down to us along the lanes.

name: Durkar
blurb: Five minutes from Durkar via Painthorpe Lane. Handy if you're coming off the M1 at J39 for a groom.

name: Kettlethorpe
blurb: A short drive from Kettlethorpe — straight down past Standbridge Lane and you're with us.

name: Calder Grove
blurb: Five minutes off the A636. Convenient if you're on the Calder Grove side of Crigglestone.

name: Hall Green
blurb: Hall Green is our home patch — the salon sits on Castle Meadows, your same WF4 3QJ postcode. No travel for you; we're just up the road. Plenty of Hall Green dogs walk down for their grooms.

name: West Bretton
blurb: Ten minutes from West Bretton. If your dog has been racing round the Yorkshire Sculpture Park grounds, we'll have them dry, tidy and tired-out.

name: Horbury
blurb: Ten minutes from Horbury. Plenty of Horbury customers prefer the quieter home setting over a busy high-street salon.

name: Notton & Woolley
blurb: Ten minutes south through the lanes. Notton and Woolley share the same quiet, semi-rural character as our patch — your dog will feel at home.

name: Haigh
blurb: Ten minutes south into Barnsley. We pick up a lot of Haigh customers — easy run up the lanes to our place.
